title: Zesty Hangover Cure Japanese Pork Ramen
description: A rich and satisfying hangover cure featuring nutty Japanese pork in a fluffy lard-based broth.
instructions: Grind the pork neck bones and pork shoulder in a mortar and pestle until coarsely ground.
In a large pot, combine the ground pork and 4 cups of water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.
Strain the pork broth through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean pot, discarding the solids.
In a small bowl, whisk together the miso paste, soy sauce, and sugar until smooth. Add the mixture to the pork broth and stir to combine.
In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of lard over medium heat. Add the ginger and cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant and slightly caramelized, about 5 minutes.
Add the ground pork to the skillet and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the remaining 2 tablespoons of lard to the skillet and stir to combine.
Bring the pork broth to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes, or until slightly thickened.
Cook the ramen noodles according to the package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked noodles, pork and ginger mixture, and bok choy. Ladle the hot broth over the top and garnish with green onions and sesame seeds.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional green onions and sesame seeds if desired.
